title: User Management
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this user?
noPermission: You don't have permission to access user management
cannotModifyRole: You don't have permission to modify this user's role
deptAdminCannotModifySelf: Department admin cannot modify their own role
creditAllocationDescription: Transfer credits from this user’s tenant pool. The first allocation enables a personal pool. It will not fall back to the tenant pool when exhausted.
creditAllocationFailed: Credit allocation failed. Please try again later.
creditAllocationUncertain: The result is not confirmed. Retry the original request to avoid allocating twice.
creditInsufficientTenant: The tenant does not have enough remaining credits for this allocation.
creditForbidden: Only super administrators and this tenant’s administrators may allocate credits.
creditInvalidAmount: Enter a positive amount within the tenant balance, with at most two decimal places.
creditNoTenant: This user has no tenant and cannot receive allocated credits.
creditRequestConflict: This request was already used with a different amount. Check the allocation record.
creditAccountMismatch: The user’s tenant has changed. Refresh and try again.
creditAccountBusy: This user is currently using credits. Try again later.
creditExhausted: Your credits are exhausted. Contact an administrator to recharge.
creditLifecycleBlocked: This user has an unsettled personal balance or an active request and cannot be deleted or moved to another tenant.
